NewDomain.description: Track another domain for an existing company.

errors.alreadyRunning: This domain already has a crawl in progress.
errors.noPriorityUrls: There are no priority pages yet. Mark some in Pages first.
errors.invalidPriorityUrl: Enter a URL of {host}, like /pricing or https://{host}/pricing.
errors.invalidSchedule: Check the frequency, day and time of the schedule.

Pages.title: Pages
Pages.neverCrawled: This domain has not been crawled yet.

incomplete.title: The last crawl stopped at its URL limit
incomplete.description: It requested {urls, number} URLs and there were more. These figures do not cover the whole site.
incomplete.settings: Raise the limit in the crawl settings.

viewHints.pages: URLs of this site that answered with HTML, whatever their status. These are the ones counted as pages.
viewHints.other: Redirects, images, stylesheets, scripts, PDFs, robots.txt, sitemaps and URLs that did not answer.
viewHints.external: URLs on other sites linked from this one. They are recorded, but never requested or counted.
viewHints.priority: Pages the priority crawl requests, with their most recent result from any crawl.

Jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
Jobs.description: Run each type of crawl now or on a recurring schedule. A domain runs one crawl at a time.

typeDescriptions.full: Requests every URL of the site: from the home page, the sitemaps and everything linked anywhere, ignoring robots.txt and meta robots.
typeDescriptions.priority: Requests only the pages marked as priority in Pages, without following their links.

schedule.hourlyHint: Only the minutes count: it runs every hour at that minute.

lastOutcome.skipped-active: Last run skipped {when}: another crawl was in progress.
lastOutcome.skipped-empty: Last run skipped {when}: no priority pages marked.

DomainSettings.title: Settings
DomainSettings.description: Everything that can be configured for {host}.

CrawlSettings.title: Crawl settings
CrawlSettings.description: How crawls of {host} behave. Changes apply from the next crawl.

rendering.label: Page rendering
rendering.hint: A headless browser finds links that only exist after running JavaScript. It is not available yet.

modes.both: HTTP and headless browser, recommended (coming soon)

userAgent.label: User-Agent
userAgent.hint: Leave it empty to use the default one. Change it if a firewall blocks the crawler.

concurrency.label: Simultaneous requests
concurrency.hint: How many requests can be in progress at once.

requestsPerSecond.label: Requests per second
requestsPerSecond.hint: The most requests per second this domain receives.

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.hint: How long to wait for a URL before giving up on it.

maxRetries.label: Retries
maxRetries.hint: Extra attempts after a network error, 429 or 503.

maxUrls.label: URL limit
maxUrls.hint: Most URLs of the site a full crawl requests. Past it, the crawl ends as incomplete. Leave it empty for no limit, at the risk of a site with endless URLs.

retention.label: Crawl results to keep

hints.latest: Allows comparing crawls, with a bounded database size.
hints.current: The lightest option. Comparing crawls URL by URL will not be possible.
hints.all: Nothing is ever deleted, so the database grows without limit.

retention.countHint: Older ones keep their summary but lose their results per URL.

optionalFiles.label: Other crawl files
optionalFiles.hint: Files to check besides robots.txt, sitemaps and llms.txt. Checked as soon as you save, in every crawl and once a day.

feed.label: RSS / Atom feeds
feed.hint: Those the home page announces, or at the usual URLs.

opensearch.label: OpenSearch
opensearch.hint: The search description of the site.

indexnow.label: IndexNow
indexnow.hint: Tells search engines about changes at once. Its file is named after a key.

indexNow.label: Key
indexNow.hint: The file is named after the key, so it cannot be found without it. It has to be 8 to 128 letters, numbers or dashes.

errors.renderingUnavailable: That rendering mode is not available yet.
errors.userAgent: The User-Agent can only have plain characters, up to {max}.
errors.concurrency: Simultaneous requests must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.requestsPerSecond: Requests per second must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.timeout: The timeout must be between {min} and {max} seconds.
errors.maxUrls: The URL limit must be between {min} and {max}, or empty for no limit.
errors.retainCrawls: The number of crawls to keep must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.indexNowKey: The IndexNow key must be 8 to 128 letters, numbers or dashes.
errors.indexNowKeyRequired: Enter the IndexNow key, or turn IndexNow off.

refresh.crawlRunning: A full crawl is checking these files already.

CrawlFiles.neverFetched: Not checked yet. It takes a moment after adding a domain.
CrawlFiles.crawlRunning: A full crawl is running: it updates these files as it goes.

unreachable.title: The site did not answer the last check
unreachable.description: No request got an answer, so this is what was found before. It will be tried again in an hour.

requests.invalidDetail: It answers with something else, usually a web page.

raw.truncated: The file is larger than this: only the beginning is kept.

robots.title: robots.txt
robots.description: What the site tells crawlers they may request. The crawler of this app records it, but does not obey it.

missing.title: There is no robots.txt
missing.description: Crawlers take that to mean they may request everything.

unavailable.title: robots.txt could not be read
unavailable.description: Search engines may stop crawling the whole site while its robots.txt answers with a server error or not at all.

invalid.title: The URL does not serve a robots.txt
invalid.description: It answers 200 with something else, usually a web page. Crawlers cannot find any rules in that.

site-blocked.title: The whole site is blocked for crawlers
site-blocked.description: The rules for every user agent disallow /. Unless a group names a crawler, it will not request anything.

too-large.title: The file is over 500 KiB
too-large.description: Google ignores whatever comes after that point, including any rules there.

no-sitemaps.title: It does not declare any sitemap
no-sitemaps.description: A Sitemap line is how crawlers that are not told otherwise find the sitemaps of a site.

origins-differ.title: Variants of the site serve different files
origins-differ.description: Rules apply per origin, so the same URL may be allowed on one variant and not on another. Compare them below.

syntax-issues.title: Some lines have problems
syntax-issues.description: Crawlers ignore what they cannot understand, so these lines probably do not do what was meant.

aiBots.title: AI bots
aiBots.description: Whether each one may crawl the site, going by these rules. Bots decide on their own whether to obey them.

groups.title: Rules by user agent
groups.description: Each group applies to the user agents above it.
groups.moreRules: And {count} more. See the file for all of them.

types.rule-outside-group: Rule with no User-agent before it

origins.title: Requests
origins.description: robots.txt applies per origin, so each variant of the site has its own.

sitemaps.title: Sitemaps
sitemaps.description: The lists of URLs the site offers crawlers, wherever they were found.

none.title: No sitemap was found
none.description: Neither robots.txt nor the usual locations lead to one.

not-declared.title: robots.txt does not declare the sitemaps
not-declared.description: They were only found by trying their usual locations. Crawlers may not do that.

declared-broken.title: robots.txt declares a sitemap that does not work
declared-broken.description: Crawlers are told to read it, and find an error instead.

empty.title: The sitemaps are empty
empty.description: They exist, but do not list any URL.

stats.urlsHint: Added up: a URL in two sitemaps counts twice.

table.title: Files
table.tried: {count, plural, one {# usual location was also tried and holds nothing, which is normal.} other {# usual locations were also tried and hold nothing, which is normal.}}

llms.title: llms.txt
llms.description: A summary of the site for AI models: what it is, and where to read about it. It is a proposal, not a standard that every AI product reads.

missing.title: There is no llms.txt
missing.description: It is optional, so this is not an error. Without it, AI models have to work out the site from its pages.

unavailable.title: llms.txt could not be read
unavailable.description: It answers with a server error, or not at all.

invalid.title: The URL does not serve an llms.txt
invalid.description: It answers 200 with something else, usually a web page.

no-title.title: It has no title
no-title.description: The format starts with a level 1 heading naming the site or project.

no-summary.title: It has no summary
no-summary.description: The format has a blockquote under the title, with a short summary.

no-links.title: It has no links
no-links.description: The format lists links to read further, under level 2 headings.

full.found: The full text for AI models, in one file: “{title}”, with {headings, plural, one {# heading} other {# headings}}.
full.missing: The optional companion with the full text in one file. This site does not have one.

extra.guessedNotFound: {count, plural, one {# usual location was tried and the home page does not announce any.} other {# usual locations were tried and the home page does not announce any.}}

disabled.title: {name} is not being checked
disabled.description: Turn it on in the crawl settings to request it in every crawl and once a day.

ads.name: ads.txt
ads.description: Who is authorized to sell the ad space of this site.

app-ads.name: app-ads.txt
app-ads.description: The same, for the apps of this developer.

security.name: security.txt
security.description: How to report a security issue (RFC 9116).

humans.name: humans.txt
humans.description: Credits for the people behind the site.

feed.name: RSS / Atom feeds
feed.description: The latest content, in a format that readers and crawlers follow.

opensearch.name: OpenSearch
opensearch.description: Lets browsers search this site directly.

indexnow.name: IndexNow key
indexnow.description: The file that proves this key may announce changes of the site to search engines.

invalid.title: Some lines are not valid
invalid.description: {count, plural, one {# line is} other {# lines are}} neither a record nor a variable: {lines}.

no-contact.title: It has no Contact field
no-contact.description: RFC 9116 requires it: it is the point of the file.

no-expiry.title: It has no valid Expires field
no-expiry.description: RFC 9116 requires one, so outdated information is not trusted forever.

expired.title: It has expired
expired.description: Past its Expires date, the file should no longer be trusted.

wrong-location.title: It is not where it should be

matches.title: The file holds this key
matches.description: Search engines will accept what is announced with it.

differs.title: The file holds something else
differs.description: It has to hold exactly the key, or search engines will refuse what is announced with it.
